applications.name: Gmail
applications.description: Search mail, read conversations, manage labels, and create drafts with Google's official remote MCP server.

setup.instructions: Enroll in the Gmail MCP Developer Preview, enable the Gmail API and Gmail MCP API, configure the OAuth consent screen, and create a Web OAuth client. Add http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback as an authorized redirect URI, then paste the client credentials below.

fields.label: OAuth client ID
fields.description: The client ID from Google Auth Platform.

fields.label: OAuth client secret
fields.description: The client secret from Google Auth Platform.

applications.name: GitHub
applications.description: Work with repositories, issues, pull requests, actions, and code through GitHub's official remote MCP server.

setup.instructions: Create a fine-grained personal access token with only the repository and organization permissions you want Newelle to use.

fields.label: Personal access token
fields.description: The token is stored with your existing MCP server settings.

applications.name: Sentry
applications.description: Investigate issues, events, traces, and projects using Sentry's hosted MCP service.

setup.instructions: Your browser will open so you can choose a Sentry account and approve access.

applications.name: Google Maps
applications.description: Search places, get directions, and access location services through the Google Maps MCP server.

setup.instructions: Create a Google Maps Platform API key with the required Maps APIs enabled, then enter it below.

fields.label: Google Maps API key
fields.description: The API key used by the Google Maps MCP server.

applications.name: GNOME
applications.description: Control selected GNOME desktop features through the community GNOME MCP server.

setup.instructions: Automatic setup needs Git and Rust/Cargo on the host. Disable it below if gnome-mcp-server is already installed and available on PATH.

additional_setup.description: Newelle downloads the GNOME MCP server into its MCP folder and runs Cargo from that checkout.
additional_setup.instructions: The first connection may take a while while Cargo downloads and builds the Rust dependencies.

applications.name: Hyprland
applications.description: Inspect and control a Hyprland desktop through its unofficial MCP server.

setup.instructions: Make sure Git and uv are installed on the host, then copy HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE from the environment of the running Hyprland session.

additional_setup.description: Newelle downloads the Hyprland MCP bridge into its MCP folder and configures the installed path automatically.
additional_setup.instructions: Keep Hyprland running with the same instance signature. If Hyprland is restarted, reconnect this server with the new HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE value.

fields.label: Hyprland instance signature
fields.description: The HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE value for the running compositor.

applications.name: KWin
applications.description: Control a KDE Plasma 6 Wayland desktop with the community KWin MCP server.

setup.instructions: Use KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland and install the server with uv tool install kwin-mcp (or pip). The uvx command must be available on PATH.

applications.name: Blender
applications.description: Connect Blender to Newelle through its MCP extension and local bridge.

setup.instructions: Install and enable the Blender Lab MCP extension from the official Blender page. Git and uv must be installed on the host.

additional_setup.description: Newelle downloads Blender's official MCP bridge into its MCP folder and configures the bridge path automatically.
additional_setup.instructions: In Blender, enable the Blender Lab MCP extension and start its local service before using the tools. Keep Blender open while this connection is enabled.

fields.label: Blender host
fields.description: Hostname of the local Blender MCP service.

fields.label: Blender port
fields.description: Port used by the Blender MCP extension.

applications.name: Kdenlive
applications.description: Control Kdenlive and automate video editing through its D-Bus MCP server.

setup.instructions: Install Git and uv, then use a Kdenlive build patched with the D-Bus scripting API. Keep Kdenlive running while you connect.

additional_setup.description: Newelle downloads the Kdenlive MCP bridge into its MCP folder and configures its Python dependencies automatically.
additional_setup.instructions: Start the patched Kdenlive build before using these tools. The regular Kdenlive release does not expose the required D-Bus scripting API.

applications.name: GIMP
applications.description: Create and edit images in GIMP through the community GIMP MCP plugin.

setup.instructions: Use GIMP 3.2+. Automatic setup is optional: enable it to download the MCP bridge, or disable it if gimp-mcp-server is already installed on PATH.

additional_setup.description: Newelle downloads the GIMP MCP bridge and plug-in into its MCP folder and runs it with Python 3.13 for native dependency compatibility.
additional_setup.instructions: Automatic setup installs gimp-mcp-plugin.py into GIMP's plug-ins folder. If automatic setup is disabled, install the plug-in manually, mark it executable, and restart GIMP. Open an image, then choose Tools > MCP > Start MCP Server before using the tools.

applications.name: Playwright
applications.description: Automate browser pages with Microsoft's official Playwright MCP server.

setup.instructions: Node.js 18+ and npx must be installed. Newelle launches a fresh stdio process for tool calls, so persistent browser profiles and long-lived login sessions may be limited.

applications.name: Email
applications.description: Read, search, and send mail with the email-mcp server for Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, and IMAP.

setup.instructions: Run npx @marlinjai/email-mcp setup once in a terminal. The wizard opens browser OAuth for Gmail or Outlook, or asks for an app-specific password/IMAP values for other providers.

applications.name: CalDAV
applications.description: Read and manage calendars through a provider-neutral CalDAV MCP server.

setup.instructions: Create an app-specific password when your calendar provider requires one, then enter the CalDAV endpoint and account details below.

fields.label: CalDAV URL
fields.description: The calendar collection or server URL.

applications.name: Obsidian
applications.description: Search and edit a local Obsidian vault with the community MCPVault server.

setup.instructions: Install Node.js 18+ and choose the local Obsidian vault that MCPVault should expose. The original mcp-obsidian repository is now maintained as mcpvault.

fields.label: Vault folder
fields.description: Only this Obsidian vault is exposed to the server.

applications.name: Hugging Face
applications.description: Search the Hub and use Hugging Face resources through the official hosted MCP server.

setup.instructions: Your browser will open so you can authenticate with Hugging Face and approve access to the Hub.

applications.name: Linear
applications.description: Query issues, projects, teams, and cycles through Linear's official remote MCP server.

setup.instructions: Your browser will open so you can sign in to Linear and authorize the connection.

applications.name: Notion
applications.description: Search, read, and update Notion pages and databases with Notion's official MCP server.

setup.instructions: Your browser will open so you can authorize Newelle with a Notion workspace.

applications.name: Canva
applications.description: Create and edit designs, search libraries, manage assets, export designs, and collaborate through Canva's official remote MCP server.

setup.instructions: Your browser will open so you can sign in to Canva and authorize Newelle. Each user must authenticate individually.

applications.name: Nextcloud Context Agent
applications.description: Access Nextcloud files, calendars, tasks, contacts, sharing, Talk, and other enabled integrations through the Context Agent MCP server.

setup.instructions: Install and configure the Nextcloud Context Agent app, then enter its MCP endpoint and an app password for the account Newelle should use.

fields.label: Nextcloud hostname
fields.description: The hostname of your Nextcloud instance, without https:// or a trailing slash.

fields.label: Nextcloud app password
fields.description: An app password for the Nextcloud account Newelle should use.

applications.name: Shiply
applications.description: Publish and manage static websites through Shiply's hosted MCP server.

setup.instructions: Anonymous publishing is available without credentials. Shiply operations for owned sites may require an API key configured separately by the service.

applications.name: Awesome MCP Tools
applications.description: Search, compare, and browse the awesome-mcp.tools catalog of MCP servers.

setup.instructions: No credentials are required to use the hosted catalog server.

applications.name: GitMCP
applications.description: Create an MCP server for a public GitHub repository so agents can understand its code and documentation in context.

setup.instructions: Enter a public GitHub repository in owner/repository format. GitMCP will create the corresponding repository-specific MCP URL.

fields.label: GitHub repository
fields.description: A public GitHub repository in owner/repository format.

applications.name: Stripe
applications.description: Work with Stripe payments, customers, billing workflows, and Stripe documentation through the official MCP server.

setup.instructions: Your browser will open so you can sign in to Stripe and authorize Newelle.

applications.name: Google Workspace Drive
applications.description: Search, read, create, copy, and inspect files and permissions in Google Drive through Google’s MCP server.

setup.instructions: Your browser will open so you can sign in to Google and authorize Drive access.

applications.name: arXiv
applications.description: Search arXiv papers, fetch metadata in batches, read full HTML content, and browse the category taxonomy.

setup.instructions: No account or authentication is required to connect to this server.

applications.name: GoDaddy
applications.description: Search for domain names and check domain availability through GoDaddy’s public MCP server.

setup.instructions: No account or API credential is required for the public domain-search tools.

applications.name: ONLYOFFICE DocSpace
applications.description: Manage DocSpace files, folders, people, and collaborative rooms through the ONLYOFFICE MCP server.

setup.instructions: Enter your DocSpace base URL and an API key with the permissions you want to expose to Newelle.

fields.label: DocSpace base URL
fields.description: The base URL of your ONLYOFFICE DocSpace instance.

fields.label: DocSpace API key
fields.description: The API key used to authenticate with your DocSpace instance.

applications.name: LibreOffice MCP
applications.description: Create, read, convert, search, and edit LibreOffice documents through the mcp-libre server.

setup.instructions: Install Git and uv, and make sure LibreOffice 24.2+ is available on the host. Newelle downloads mcp-libre and resolves its Python environment automatically.

additional_setup.description: Newelle downloads the mcp-libre repository into its MCP setup folder and uses uv to run the server from that checkout.
additional_setup.instructions: Keep LibreOffice installed and accessible from the command line. The repository can optionally use LIBREOFFICE_PATH when LibreOffice is not on the default PATH.

applications.name: Kubernetes
applications.description: Inspect and operate Kubernetes clusters with the Kubernetes SIGs MCP server.

setup.instructions: Install uvx and choose a kubeconfig file with the cluster permissions you want to expose. Use a least-privilege service account where possible.

fields.label: Kubeconfig
fields.description: The kubeconfig used by the MCP server.
